opening.argument: The presentation directly promotes joining BitClub Network's mining opportunity by promising substantially greater Bitcoin holdings than simply buying and storing Bitcoin. It says that joining the mining club would “probably have, from 2 to 8 times more bitcoin” after three years, making the club's potential returns the central appeal. The message then reinforces that appeal with an explicit invitation: “Bitclub Network has great potential. Stay with us!” It also urges viewers not to miss the opportunity, stating, “do not stay out of this is real.” Taken together, these statements present participation in the club as a way to obtain superior Bitcoin returns and press viewers to join or remain involved, rather than merely explaining Bitcoin technology.
